scripts.speaker: Assassin Cross
scripts.text:
We are the warriors
of the desert. Nobody
looks down upon us.
Nobody...

scripts.speaker: Assassin Cross
scripts.text:
The time has come.
The world needs you...
More than ever.

scripts.speaker: Assassin Cross
scripts.text: I ask that you continue to live in the shadows, but as an even greater Assassin with a new appearance.

scripts.speaker: Assassin Cross
scripts.text:
Will you become
an Assassin Cross?

scripts.speaker: Assassin Cross
scripts.text:
When you are
ready, come back.

scripts.speaker: Assassin Cross
scripts.text:
You still haven't
learned everything
that you can.

scripts.speaker: Assassin Cross
scripts.text:
Use all your
Skill Points
and then come back.

scripts.speaker: Assassin Cross
scripts.text:
Congratulations.
As an Assassin Cross,
I hope that you fight for a brighter future within the darkness.

scripts.speaker: Assassin Cross
scripts.text:
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.

scripts.speaker: Assassin Cross
scripts.text:
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors.
